calendarNotes: August 20 is used as the first day because Olentangy's historical Events calendar labels it First Day of School. September 15, October 17, October 20, December 1, January 2, February 13, March 13, and April 6 are staff or conference-exchange dates with no school for students, so families need childcare even when staff report. Quarter-ending dates are academic markers rather than closures unless a separate no-school event follows. Winter Break is listed through January 1 and the January 2 teacher workday keeps students out until classes resume January 5. Spring Break runs March 30 through April 3 and is followed by an April 6 Conference Exchange Day, extending the student time away from school through that Monday. May 28 is the last student day and only grades K–5 receive the printed two-hour early dismissal. Graduation is listed May 30 on the official historical calendar, but ceremony details should still be confirmed with the student's high school.

customSections.label: Why There Is No Official PDF Button
customSections.content: The supplied local file is a two-page OhioSchools.us recreation made after the school year had started; it is not an archived Olentangy document. This page therefore uses the district's live historical Events entries as the source of record, suppresses the PDF module, and omits August staff/open-house dates that could not be verified in the reviewed districtwide view.

customSections.label: The Final Week Has Three Different Audiences
customSections.content: Memorial Day closes school May 25. May 28 is the student ending with a K–5-only two-hour early dismissal, May 29 is a teacher workday after students finish, and May 30 is graduation. Reading those entries as one universal schedule would give older students and staff the wrong ending.

calendarFaqs.q: When did Olentangy Schools start in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: The official historical Events calendar lists Wednesday, August 20, 2025 as the First Day of School.

calendarFaqs.q: When was Olentangy Winter Break in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break ran December 22, 2025 through January 1, 2026. A teacher workday kept students out January 2, and classes resumed January 5.

calendarFaqs.q: When was Olentangy Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break ran March 30 through April 3, 2026. Students also had no school April 6 for a Conference Exchange Day.

calendarFaqs.q: When was the last day of Olentangy school in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: The last student day was Thursday, May 28, 2026, with a two-hour early dismissal for grades K–5 only.

calendarFaqs.q: Is the downloadable 2025–26 Olentangy PDF official?
calendarFaqs.a: No official district PDF URL was available. The supplied local file identifies OhioSchools.us as its creator, so this page does not offer it as an official download and instead uses verified district Events entries.
No. October 16, December 19, and March 12 were academic markers; separate events identify the no-school day that followed each quarter.
